out.subject: 1.4404 bar – committed volume and discount tier
out.body:
Dear Mr Aigner,

Thank you for your offer and the explanation of the market factors behind it. For the revised calculation, I would like to put a firm volume basis on the table rather than leave you working from an enquiry quantity.

Our proposed commitment is 94,800 kg per year throughout a 24-month contract. The attached CSV lists the monthly quantities for your share; please also see the forecast figures below. Please apply your dedicated volume discount tier to this committed annual quantity.

I propose the following packages, both with payment at 90 days net:

EUR 5.20/kg, with an AS-14404 index clause and a 5% deadband, for 24 months.
Alternatively, EUR 5.15/kg, with an AS-14404 index clause and a 3% deadband, for 24 months.

Both index clauses use a 45% material share and August 2026 as the base month. This gives you an index mechanism alongside the volume commitment, rather than the unindexed arrangement in your offer.

Please confirm which package you can support and how the dedicated volume tier is reflected in your calculation.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, Purchasing
out.rationale: Provide the committed annual volume and monthly forecast needed for a volume-tier calculation, while offering indexed packages with different deadbands. Use only the forecast claim in this opening round.

I have attached the monthly forecast again for your calculation. Our purchase-order record below also supports this being established business with you.

Your text rules out 90 days net, but your main package lists those terms. Please confirm whether that package is available. I have included a revised proposal at 60 days net to accommodate the compromise you requested:

EUR 5.14/kg at 60 days net, or EUR 5.17/kg at 90 days net. Both proposals are for 24 months with an AS-14404 index clause, a 5% deadband, a 45% material share and August 2026 as the base month.

Please price the dedicated volume tier against these packages and show how the committed annual quantity is reflected in the base price. The volume and monthly breakdown should now give you a concrete basis for that calculation.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, Purchasing

out.subject: Indexed price package and alloy surcharge treatment
out.body:
Dear Mr Aigner,

Thank you for incorporating the verified PPI data into your calculation and accepting the tighter deadband. I also appreciate your confirmation that the volume discount is included.

Your description of EUR 5.48/kg as a base price with an alloy surcharge added leaves the invoiced price unclear. We need to distinguish the initial price from subsequent index adjustments, rather than apply an additional surcharge to an already indexed price.

I propose EUR 5.35/kg with payment at 45 days net for 24 months. The AS-14404 clause retains the 3% deadband, a 45% material share and August 2026 as the base month. The proposed annual quantity remains 94,800 kg.

In this package, EUR 5.35/kg is the complete price at the base month, including the alloy component and volume discount. Subsequent adjustments apply through the agreed index clause, not through a separate alloy surcharge on top. The shorter payment period gives you a concrete improvement in return.

Please confirm whether you can agree to this package and this treatment of the alloy component.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, Purchasing

Thank you for reducing your offer and confirming that the price includes the alloy component and volume discount, with no separate alloy surcharge. That resolves the pricing ambiguity.

To answer your question about the figures: my request draws on the published PPI-C2431 data identified below and the committed annual quantity of 94,800 kg. I am not proposing a recalculation of your AS-14404 or LCI-C cost shares. I have reattached the monthly forecast so that your calculation has the quantity breakdown alongside the market evidence.

In return for a further price adjustment, I propose shortening payment to 30 days net. The revised package is EUR 5.39/kg for 24 months, with the AS-14404 clause retaining the 3% deadband, 45% material share and August 2026 base month.

EUR 5.39/kg is the complete price at the base month, including the alloy component and volume discount. Subsequent adjustments would apply exclusively through that index clause, as you have confirmed.

Can you agree to this package on that basis?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, Purchasing
